description:
Send a message to your token's holders

Sends a message from the token page `id` to its subscribed holders: in-app always, plus whichever of `push`, `email`, `sms`, `telegram`, `discord` and `xmtp` are listed and each holder has turned on. It goes out at once unless `scheduledAt` is set. A sent message cannot be recalled. Only the page's owner or a manager can send; there is nothing to sign.

With no holder group and no segment, `telegram`/`discord` also post once in the token's public community room and Discord webhook; with either, they are DMs only.

Limits: the Free plan sends 1 per rolling 7 days per token; paid plans have no plan limit, but every token is held to a safety ceiling (3 an hour and 10 a day by default, 1 a day in a token's first week), and both answer 429 with `resetsAt`. Up to 50,000 recipients per send, largest holders first. A new token's first send to more than 500 holders is held for review: it answers 200 with `recipientCount: 0` and goes out once released.

`wallet` must be one of the caller's signed-in wallets (it is recorded as the sender), and `channels` must include `inapp`. When the same token id exists on more than one chain, `crownChain` picks the token; without it the message can reach the wrong token's holders or none. Every link and image is screened: links on a blocklist and images not on IPFS or Arweave answer 422.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy, allowing changes (scope api:write).

accessTierId.description: Make the message holders-only for this holder group on the token page's feed. Needs the page owner's paid plan.

chainScope.description: Chain key the broadcast is anchored on; omit for off-chain

crownChain.description: Chain key of the token page. Needed whenever the token id exists on more than one chain.

id.description: The token page's id (the registration's numeric token id)

richContent.description: Rich-text body as the composer produces it

scheduledAt.description: Send later instead of now; at least 5 minutes ahead

segments.description: Narrow to holders in ANY of these segments (within the holder group, if one is set)

tierIds.description: Holder groups to send to (any of them). Omit for every subscribed holder; an empty list is refused. Needs the page owner's paid plan.

wallet.description: The sender; must be one of the caller's signed-in wallets

name: send_holder_broadcast

recipientCount.description: Holders queued now. 0 when scheduled, or when the send is held for review.

title: Message your token's holders
